page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 804 at upper left. Main text in one column of full lines, with a diagonal-free block of text. Marginal notes in the left margin (Tomi Constantin..., Zonar, Theophan., Cedren.). A small ornament and a catchword-like word "Caput" lower right. Faint text at right margin edge is show-through or edge and is omitted.

main_text.p: quae describebantur vino corrupta fuisset, eodem emendanda accepit. Monachi Leo- nem immunes a vectigalibus fecit. Huic Leo Imperator quondam aliud Principem imaginum cultum ignominia affixit, eo Theophanes interfectus est, Irene impe- culo fuit. Irene, mortuo Leone, imagines restituit, & monachos cum monasteriis re- Tomi Con- stantin. Zonar. Theophan. & Cedren.xenodochia reduxit. Eliopandus Icopus in Neilomarathi tuta sacerdotis ... lacus nobilis, in Patriarchatu Constantinopolitano politicum electus est. Ibidem decretum de restitutione imaginum & cultu imaginum sanctorum datum est, quo utrique adversatur, ... celebratum est, cujus decreto ... turae imagines, praeteritis in Ecclesiam ... pti; sed cultu divino ... Tum etiam Epiphanius Thaumaturgus ... naturae genus & Brumensem illustrem fuit.

page.notes: Much of the text is faded and damaged by show-through and stains; many words are uncertain and are rendered as ellipses in the reading above where illegible. Greek ornament below the text is omitted. The lower-right word "Caput" is treated as a marker. Right-edge marks are omitted.
